"""Credential-free SDK creation capability probe; no app, model or network."""
import importlib.metadata
import json
from pathlib import Path

from opentelemetry import trace
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace import SpanProcessor, TracerProvider
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export import SimpleSpanProcessor
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export.in_memory_span_exporter import InMemorySpanExporter
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.sampling import Decision, Sampler, SamplingResult
from opentelemetry.trace import SpanKind
from galileo_core.schemas.logging.span import LlmSpan
from splunk_ao.otel import start_splunk_ao_span

initial = {
    "gen_ai.operation.name": "chat",
    "gen_ai.provider.name": "ollama",
    "gen_ai.request.model": "qwen3:8b",
    "server.address": "127.0.0.1",
    "server.port": 11434,
}
samples, starts = [], []


class RecordingSampler(Sampler):
    def should_sample(self, parent_context, trace_id, name, kind=SpanKind.INTERNAL,
                      attributes=None, links=None, trace_state=None):
        samples.append({"name": name, "kind": kind.name,
                        "attributes": dict(attributes or {})})
        return SamplingResult(Decision.RECORD_AND_SAMPLE,
                              attributes=dict(attributes or {}))

    def get_description(self):
        return "RecordingAlwaysOn"


class RecordingStarts(SpanProcessor):
    def on_start(self, span, parent_context=None):
        starts.append({"name": span.name, "kind": span.kind.name,
                       "attributes": dict(span.attributes or {})})

    def on_end(self, span):
        pass

    def shutdown(self):
        pass

    def force_flush(self, timeout_millis=30000):
        return True


exporter = InMemorySpanExporter()
provider = TracerProvider(sampler=RecordingSampler())
provider.add_span_processor(RecordingStarts())
provider.add_span_processor(SimpleSpanProcessor(exporter))
trace.set_tracer_provider(provider)
record = LlmSpan(name="chat helper-probe", model="qwen3:8b",
                 input=[{"role": "user", "content": "Synthetic check"}],
                 output={"role": "assistant", "content": "Synthetic answer"})
with start_splunk_ao_span(record) as span:
    span.set_attributes(initial)
tracer = provider.get_tracer("creation-control")
with tracer.start_as_current_span("chat standard-otel-control",
                                  kind=SpanKind.CLIENT, attributes=initial):
    pass
provider.force_flush()
finished = [{"name": span.name, "kind": span.kind.name,
             "attributes": dict(span.attributes or {}),
             "trace_id": format(span.context.trace_id, "032x"),
             "span_id": format(span.context.span_id, "016x")}
            for span in exporter.get_finished_spans()]
assert len(samples) == len(starts) == len(finished) == 2
assert samples[0]["kind"] == starts[0]["kind"] == finished[0]["kind"] == "INTERNAL"
assert samples[0]["attributes"] == starts[0]["attributes"] == {}
assert all(finished[0]["attributes"][key] == value for key, value in initial.items())
assert samples[1]["kind"] == starts[1]["kind"] == "CLIENT"
assert samples[1]["attributes"] == starts[1]["attributes"] == initial
receipt = {
    "proof_scope": "Installed public SDK helper + standard OTel in-memory export. RecordingAlwaysOn observes should_sample and on_start inputs; no attribute-dependent DROP policy, model/app, OTLP wire, AO exporter, resources or cloud execution.",
    "versions": {p: importlib.metadata.version(p)
                 for p in ["splunk-ao", "galileo-core", "opentelemetry-sdk"]},
    "sampling_inputs": samples, "on_start_records": starts,
    "finished_records": finished,
    "pass": ["helper creation INTERNAL with empty attributes",
             "helper same-span setters present at finish",
             "existing public OTel control supplies CLIENT and initial attributes"],
}
Path(__file__).with_suffix(".json").write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + "\n")
provider.shutdown()
print(json.dumps({"versions": receipt["versions"], "pass": receipt["pass"]}))
